nodes.name: guildMemberUpdate.js
nodes.summary: guildMemberUpdate event handler that logs member changes — role grants/removals, guild ownership transfers, and nickname changes — to the members log channel with audit-log moderator attribution.

nodes.name: guildUpdate.js
nodes.summary: guildUpdate event handler that logs guild setting changes — AFK channel, description, and name updates — to the guild-updates log channel with before/after details and moderator attribution from the audit log.

nodes.name: messageDelete.js
nodes.summary: messageDelete event handler that logs deleted messages with author, channel, send time, and a content snapshot to the messages log channel, skipping uncached messages without an author.

nodes.name: messageUpdate.js
nodes.summary: messageUpdate event handler that logs edited messages by comparing old and new content (truncated to 1024 characters) and posting a before/after embed to the messages log channel.

nodes.name: roleCreate.js
nodes.summary: roleCreate event handler that logs newly created roles with the responsible moderator resolved from the RoleCreate audit log entry.

nodes.name: roleDelete.js
nodes.summary: roleDelete event handler that logs deleted roles with the moderator identified through the guild audit log.

nodes.name: roleUpdate.js
nodes.summary: roleUpdate event handler that detects role icon, color, name, and permission changes, posting before/after log embeds attributed to the audit-log executor.

nodes.name: voiceStateUpdate.js
nodes.summary: voiceStateUpdate event handler covering voice joins/leaves, server mute and deafen toggles, streaming and camera changes, and cross-channel moves with member counts, all logged to the voice log channel.

nodes.name: db.js
nodes.summary: Central settings persistence layer that routes guild-scoped keys (anti-protection toggles, limits, whitelists, language, log channels) through a JSON-backed cache while falling back to a raw key-value store, plus typo normalization and projects.json load/save helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a pro.db key-value library with hand-rolled JSON files, using file mtime comparison to invalidate an in-memory cache instead of reloading on every read.

nodes.name: proDbGet
nodes.summary: Reads a key from the JSON-backed pro.db store using an mtime-validated in-memory cache so unchanged files are never re-parsed.

nodes.name: proDbSet
nodes.summary: Writes a key to pro.db, updates the local cache, refreshes the cache mtime, and logs write failures without throwing.

nodes.name: proDbDelete
nodes.summary: Deletes a key from pro.db and the in-memory cache, short-circuiting when the key is not present.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Resolves a settings key by splitting the guild prefix and routing language, log-channel, punishment, limit, whitelist, and anti-protection settings through guild settings with fallback to the raw key-value store.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Persists a settings key by writing guild-scoped anti, language, log-channel, and punishment settings into the guild settings file, and everything else into the raw key-value store.

nodes.name: del
nodes.summary: Removes a settings key, deleting guild-scoped settings from the persisted guild settings file and other keys from the raw store.

nodes.name: loadProjects
nodes.summary: Loads and caches projects.json, recovering from read or parse errors by resetting the cache to an empty object and rewriting the file.

nodes.name: saveProjects
nodes.summary: Serializes the projects object back to projects.json asynchronously, logging any write failure.

nodes.name: ticket.js
nodes.summary: Ticket interaction handlers for close, confirm-close, delete, reopen, transcript, claim/unclaim, and legacy project-decision buttons, each gated by staff permission checks and wired to logging and rating requests.

nodes.name: countOpenTickets
nodes.summary: Counts open ticket channels by matching the ticket emoji prefix inside the configured ticket category.

nodes.name: handleCloseTicket
nodes.summary: Validates that the requester is staff or the ticket owner, then posts the close-confirmation panel while guarding against duplicate prompts.

nodes.name: handleConfirmClose
nodes.summary: Locks the ticket by rewriting permission overwrites, posts transcript/refresh/delete controls, archives an HTML transcript to the archive channel and the owner, and DMs a 1–5 star rating request.

nodes.name: handleDeleteTicket
nodes.summary: Staff-only handler that logs the deletion and removes the ticket channel.

nodes.name: handleReopenTicket
nodes.summary: Staff-only handler that restores owner access, strips the claim suffix from the channel name, re-tracks the ticket in the idle system, and logs the reopen.

nodes.name: handleTranscript
nodes.summary: Generates a full HTML transcript, posts it to the archive channel and DMs it to the ticket owner, then disables the transcript button.

nodes.name: handleClaimTicket
nodes.summary: Lets staff claim a ticket by swapping the welcome button to Unclaim, posting a claim notice, and logging the action.

nodes.name: handleUnclaimTicket
nodes.summary: Reverses a claim by deleting the claim notice, restoring the Claim button on the welcome message, and logging the unclaim.

nodes.name: hasButton
nodes.summary: Recursively searches a component tree for a button carrying the given custom ID.

nodes.name: handleProjectAccept
nodes.summary: Staff-gated wrapper that delegates project acceptance to the projectTicket module.

nodes.name: handleProjectDecline
nodes.summary: Staff-gated wrapper that delegates project decline to the projectTicket module.

nodes.name: handleDeclineReasonSubmit
nodes.summary: Staff-gated wrapper forwarding the decline-reason modal submission to projectTicket.

nodes.name: handleProjectTypeSelect
nodes.summary: Backward-compatibility wrapper that forwards project_type_select interactions to the projectTicket handler.

nodes.name: idleSystem.js
nodes.summary: Tracks open ticket channels and auto-closes them after prolonged inactivity, warning the owner and staff at the halfway point and persisting per-ticket rating-request state.

nodes.name: getOriginalOwner
nodes.summary: Resolves the ticket owner by scanning permission overwrites while ignoring the guild, staff, and manager roles.

nodes.name: closeTicket
nodes.summary: Auto-closes an idle ticket by revoking owner access, renaming the channel, posting an inactivity notice, and dropping it from the tracker.

nodes.name: sendWarning
nodes.summary: Posts the 12-hour inactivity warning mentioning the ticket owner and staff role.

nodes.name: initIdleSystem
nodes.summary: Starts a 60-second interval sweep that warns after 12 hours of silence and closes tickets 12 hours later if still inactive.

nodes.name: resetIdleTimer
nodes.summary: Refreshes a ticket's idle countdown on new activity, unless a warning was already issued.

nodes.name: trackTicket
nodes.summary: Registers a channel in the tracker map with idle, owner, and rating-request state.

nodes.name: untrackTicket
nodes.summary: Removes a channel from the idle tracker map.

nodes.name: isTracked
nodes.summary: Reports whether a channel is currently tracked by the idle system.

nodes.name: hasOpenTicket
nodes.summary: Returns the channel ID of a user's still-open tracked ticket, or null.

nodes.name: hasRatingBeenRequested
nodes.summary: Checks whether the rating prompt has already been sent for a ticket.

nodes.name: markRatingRequested
nodes.summary: Flags a ticket so the rating request is not sent twice.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Main Discord bot entry point: builds the client with full gateway intents, dynamically loads slash and prefix commands, and registers the interaction, message, and channel-delete handlers that drive tickets, applications, question flows, giveaways, and AI features.

nodes.name: loadCommands
nodes.summary: Recursively walks the Commands directory and collects every module exposing both data and execute into the slash-command registry.

nodes.name: loadPrefixCommands
nodes.summary: Recursively loads prefix commands and their aliases from the PrefixCommands directory into the command and alias Maps.

nodes.name: protectionEvents.js
nodes.summary: Server protection module that registers message and audit-log listeners for anti-link, anti-scam, and anti-spam enforcement with per-guild rate limiting, styled log messages, and configurable punishments.

nodes.name: getRateCounter
nodes.summary: Returns a 10-minute sliding-window rate counter for a key, creating or resetting it when the window has expired.

nodes.name: sendProtectionLog
nodes.summary: Posts a styled Components-v2 protection log entry to the configured guild log channel.

nodes.name: applyPunishment
nodes.summary: Applies the configured punishment to an offending member: strip all roles, kick, or ban.

nodes.name: ratingHandler.js
nodes.summary: Handles the star-rating buttons sent in DMs after a ticket closes, records the score, and re-renders the message with the buttons disabled.

nodes.name: handleRatingInteraction
nodes.summary: Parses the dm_rate_* custom ID to recover the score, ticket channel, and closer, logs the rating, and edits the message into a thank-you confirmation.

nodes.name: aiHandler.js
nodes.summary: Multi-provider AI chat engine that fans requests out across Gemini, OpenRouter, and Groq with per-model fallback, exponential backoff, per-user session history, and TTL-based session cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: In-memory sessions live in a Map with a 30-minute TTL swept every 5 minutes; auth errors (400/401/403) skip the rest of a provider's models while 429/5xx errors trigger capped exponential backoff.

nodes.name: getActiveProviders
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered provider list (preferred provider first) from whichever AI API keys are present in the environment.

nodes.name: getAIResponse
nodes.summary: Sends a user message through each active provider and model with fallback and backoff, appends the exchange to the session history (capped at 20 turns), and returns the generated reply.

nodes.name: clearUserSession
nodes.summary: Deletes a user's chat session from memory, ending their conversation context.

nodes.name: getActiveSessionCount
nodes.summary: Returns the number of live chat sessions for monitoring.

nodes.name: dmHandler.js
nodes.summary: Routes incoming direct messages to the shared AI responder, showing a typing indicator, chunking long replies, and falling back to a friendly error message on failure.

nodes.name: handleDM
nodes.summary: Generates an AI reply for a DM and sends it in 2000-character chunks, catching and reporting provider failures.

nodes.name: monitor.js
nodes.summary: Lightweight runtime memory monitor that logs heap, RSS, and external usage every five minutes and warns when the heap crosses 400 MB.

nodes.name: logMemory
nodes.summary: Logs heap, RSS, and external memory usage with an optional label.

nodes.name: getMemoryStats
nodes.summary: Returns formatted memory usage and formatted uptime for status reporting.

nodes.name: startMonitoring
nodes.summary: Schedules periodic memory logging, a 400 MB threshold warning check, and an initial startup snapshot.

nodes.name: serverContext.js
nodes.summary: Exports the large system prompt defining the LUNEXIS AI assistant's persona, service scope, hard rules, and escalation behavior, shared by every AI provider call.
nodes.languageNotes: A single template-literal constant exported as SERVER_CONTEXT and injected as the system instruction for Gemini, OpenRouter, and Groq requests alike.

nodes.name: server.js
nodes.summary: Express and Socket.IO web layer providing /health and /status endpoints, admin character CRUD and DB-rotation routes, JWT-authenticated real-time messaging, periodic message cleanup, graceful shutdown, and 404/500 handlers.

nodes.name: startDatabaseCleanup
nodes.summary: Schedules a six-hour interval that purges chat messages older than six hours from the message collections.

nodes.name: gracefulShutdown
nodes.summary: Handles SIGINT/SIGTERM by flushing pending file writes, closing the HTTP server, and force-exiting after a 10-second timeout.

nodes.name: supportAI.js
nodes.summary: Runs a second dedicated support-bot client that answers DMs, mentions, and support-channel messages with the shared AI responder, logging escalations to supportAI.json and pinging the admin role when needed.

nodes.name: loadSupportLog
nodes.summary: Reads the supportAI.json escalation log into memory, tolerating missing or malformed files.

nodes.name: saveSupportLog
nodes.summary: Persists the escalation log asynchronously through the shared file-write helper.

nodes.name: handleSupportMessage
nodes.summary: Filters messages for DMs, bot mentions, or the configured support channel, gets an AI reply, detects escalation triggers and uncertainty, and pings the admin role while logging the escalation.

nodes.name: initSupportAI
nodes.summary: Creates the secondary Discord client for the support bot and wires its messageCreate and ready listeners when a support token is configured.

nodes.name: startSupportAI
nodes.summary: Logs the support client in with the configured SUPPORT_BOT_TOKEN, warning if it was never initialized.

nodes.name: ticketLogger.js
nodes.summary: Posts styled Components-v2 log messages for ticket actions and service ratings to the configured log channels.

nodes.name: logTicketAction
nodes.summary: Formats and sends a ticket action log (closed, deleted, claimed, reopened, transcript) with actor, channel, and timestamp to the logs channel.

nodes.name: logTicketRating
nodes.summary: Posts a star-rating log entry showing the score, rater, closer, and a jump link to the ticket in the rating channel.

nodes.name: aiDetector.js
nodes.summary: Scores application answers for AI-generated text using phrase signatures, lexical diversity, burstiness, punctuation, and typo heuristics, emitting weighted signals consumed by the portfolio scanner.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines regex phrase matching with lightweight statistical heuristics (type-token ratio, sentence-length variance) instead of calling an external AI classifier.

nodes.name: analyzeAIGenerated
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the five AI-text sub-analyzers, collects their signals into a result object, and derives an overall AI score from the combined heuristics.

nodes.name: detectAIPhrases
nodes.summary: Scans text against weighted AI-typical phrase signatures and returns matching phrases as scoring signals.

nodes.name: estimatePerplexity
nodes.summary: Estimates text perplexity proxies from type-token ratio, word-length variance, stopword ratio, and common-word frequency to flag formulaic, low-diversity writing.

nodes.name: analyzeBurstiness
nodes.summary: Measures sentence-length variation (coefficient of variation) to detect the uniform rhythm typical of machine-generated text.

nodes.name: analyzePunctuation
nodes.summary: Analyzes em-dash usage, exclamation/question ratios, and quote habits to produce punctuation-based AI signals.

nodes.name: detectTyposSimple
nodes.summary: Counts common misspellings as a low-typo signal, since polished AI text rarely contains them.

nodes.name: fakeDetector.js
nodes.summary: Detects fabricated or low-effort application answers by matching fake-answer keywords, running per-question analyzers, flagging repetitive or suspicious patterns, and validating portfolio URLs.

nodes.name: analyzeFake
nodes.summary: Entry point for fake-answer detection: runs keyword, per-question, suspicious-pattern, and URL checks, then aggregates their signals into a fake score.

nodes.name: matchKeywords
nodes.summary: Matches answer text against categorized FAKE_KEYWORDS regex sets and reports the matched phrases as signals.

nodes.name: analyzeQuestions
nodes.summary: Normalizes each question key and delegates the answer to its dedicated analyzer from QUESTION_ANALYZERS, collecting the resulting signals.

nodes.name: detectSuspiciousPatterns
nodes.summary: Flags repeated sentences, excessive capitalization, and high link density as indicators of copy-pasted or auto-generated answers.

nodes.name: legitimacyCheck.js
nodes.summary: Combines the fake, stolen, and AI sub-scores into a clamped 0-100 legitimacy score with explanatory signals.

nodes.name: analyzeLegitimacy
nodes.summary: Derives a final legitimacy score by inverting and clamping the fake, stolen, and AI scores, appending a signal for each contributing factor.

nodes.name: stolenDetector.js
nodes.summary: Flags potentially copied or plagiarized application answers through keyword heuristics, markdown formatting consistency, skill-versus-role mismatches, and suspicious media or link usage.

nodes.name: analyzeStolen
nodes.summary: Entry point for stolen-content detection: runs the keyword, formatting-consistency, skill-mismatch, and media-link checks and aggregates their signals.

nodes.name: matchStolenKeywords
nodes.summary: Matches answer text against STOLEN_KEYWORDS regex sets (inconsistencies, generic buzzwords) and returns matched phrases as signals.

nodes.name: analyzeFormattingConsistency
nodes.summary: Compares markdown formatting and answer-sentence capitalization across answers to spot evidence of text assembled from multiple sources.

nodes.name: detectSkillMismatches
nodes.summary: Compares skills claimed in answers against the expected skills for the selected role, flagging missing and unrelated skills as mismatch signals.

nodes.name: analyzeMediaLinks
nodes.summary: Scrutinizes image and video links plus nearby disclaimer wording (e.g. 'not mine', 'found online') to flag non-original portfolio media.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Main orchestrator of the portfolio scanner: preprocesses application answers, runs the fake/stolen/AI/legitimacy analyzers plus work-sample checks, applies scoring adjustments, classifies the result, and persists per-user scan history.
nodes.languageNotes: Pipeline-style orchestration: a single scanPortfolio function chains preprocess → analyze → adjust → classify → recommend steps, each step pushing human-readable signals into a shared result object.

nodes.name: saveScanEntry
nodes.summary: Appends a scan result to the user's JSON scan history file, trimming it to the retained maximum and writing asynchronously.

nodes.name: analyzeWorkSamples
nodes.summary: Extracts portfolio URLs from project answers, matches them against known portfolio platforms and fake-portfolio patterns, and scores platform diversity.

nodes.name: buildUncertainReport
nodes.summary: Builds a fallback report shape with an 'uncertain' status when a scan cannot be completed (e.g. answers too short).

nodes.name: scanPortfolio
nodes.summary: Full portfolio-scan pipeline: guards answer length, preprocesses text, runs all four analyzers, computes and adjusts scores, classifies the portfolio, generates a recommendation, and saves the scan entry.

nodes.name: adjustments.js
nodes.summary: Score adjustment helpers that guard minimum answer length, weigh age and experience level, detect non-native language cues, review prior submissions, and apply bounded corrections to analyzer scores.

nodes.name: guardMinimumLength
nodes.summary: Computes total answer length and reports whether it meets the minimum required for a reliable scan.

nodes.name: adjustForAge
nodes.summary: Applies age-based score deltas (e.g. under-age applicants) while keeping every score clamped between 0 and 100.

nodes.name: detectNonNativeIndicators
nodes.summary: Tests answers against non-native English patterns so language differences are not mistaken for AI-generated text.

nodes.name: checkUserHistory
nodes.summary: Compares a submission with the user's previous submissions to flag repeated scores, reused project lists, or recycled answers.

nodes.name: validateBorderlineCase
nodes.summary: Re-examines borderline scans and proposes corrections based on answer completeness and typo frequency.

nodes.name: applyCorrections
nodes.summary: Applies proposed score corrections with clamping so adjusted scores remain in the 0-100 range.

nodes.name: applyExperienceAdjustment
nodes.summary: Applies experience-level-specific score deltas and thresholds from EXPERIENCE_ADJUSTMENTS, clamped to bounds.

nodes.name: applyLanguageAdjustment
nodes.summary: Shifts AI and legitimacy scores when non-native language indicators were detected, keeping results clamped.

nodes.name: keywordSets.js
nodes.summary: Central constants module holding every regex keyword set, portfolio platform domain list, AI phrase signature, per-question analyzer, typo list, and role-to-skill mapping used across the portfolio scanner.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data module: 10 exported constants including weighted regex signatures and per-question scoring closures, with no side effects.

nodes.name: preprocessor.js
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw application answers into a single whitespace-collapsed corpus string for downstream analysis.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Joins all answers into one string, then strips carriage returns, tabs, and repeated whitespace so analyzers see a clean corpus.

nodes.name: scoring.js
nodes.summary: Converts analyzer signals into clamped fake/stolen/AI/legit scores, classifies the portfolio into risk categories, and generates reviewer recommendations.

nodes.name: calculateScores
nodes.summary: Converts the four analyzer results into normalized 0-100 scores by clamping their raw values.

nodes.name: classifyPortfolio
nodes.summary: Ranks the score categories and assigns the portfolio a classification (e.g. legitimate, suspicious, likely fake) with a matching label and description.

nodes.name: generateRecommendation
nodes.summary: Turns the final report into an actionable reviewer recommendation with action level and next-step guidance.

nodes.name: urlChecker.js
nodes.summary: Extracts URLs from answer text, classifies them against legitimate, suspicious, and fake platform lists, and optionally validates them asynchronously via DNS lookup.

nodes.name: analyzeUrlsSync
nodes.summary: Synchronously extracts URLs, normalizes hostnames, classifies them against known platform lists, and flags link-shorteners, bare IP hosts, and suspicious domains.

nodes.name: validateUrlsAsync
nodes.summary: Asynchronously resolves each extracted URL's hostname via DNS to confirm the link is reachable and real.

nodes.name: addadmin.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that adds a mentioned or ID-provided user to the per-guild auto-rating admin list, rejecting bots and duplicate entries.

nodes.name: adminslist.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that displays the guild's configured auto-rating admins as a numbered embed, with a setup hint when the list is empty.

nodes.name: ratingstatus.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that reports whether auto-rating is active for the guild, including the configured channel and the randomized 1–2 hour interval.

nodes.name: removeadmin.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that removes a mentioned or ID-provided user from the auto-rating admin list, replying with a confirmation or not-found embed.

nodes.name: sendmassratings.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that validates a 1–100 count and loops sending randomly generated rating embeds to the configured channel, tracking sent/failed counts and editing a progress message into a summary.

nodes.name: sendrating.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that manually triggers one rating embed by picking a random non-bot member and posting it to the configured auto-rating channel.

nodes.name: setratingchannel.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that resolves a mentioned or ID-provided text channel and registers it as the auto-rating target, starting the scheduling loop.

nodes.name: stopratings.js
nodes.summary: Prefix command module that disables auto-rating for the guild by clearing its configuration and cancelling the pending timer, after verifying it was active.

nodes.name: autoRating.js
nodes.summary: Core auto-rating engine holding in-memory per-guild admin and channel stores, generators for randomized fake 'Verified Customer' review embeds, a self-rescheduling 1–2 hour timer loop, and the admin/status helpers consumed by the prefix commands.
nodes.languageNotes: CommonJS module exposing its API via a single module.exports object; all state lives in module-level Maps (no persistence), and the scheduler is a self-rescheduling setTimeout chain rather than setInterval.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Resolves a target user from a mention or ID, rejects bots, calls addAdmin, and replies with a green confirmation embed or a warning when the user is already listed.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Fetches the guild's auto-rating admins via getAdmins and renders a numbered list embed with a total-count footer, or a setup hint when empty.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Reads the guild's rating status and replies with an embed showing channel, interval, and active state, or prompts the user to run setratingchannel when nothing is configured.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Resolves a target user from a mention or ID, calls removeAdmin, and replies with a removal confirmation or a warning when the user is not in the admin list.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Validates a 1–100 count and the configured channel, then loops picking random members and posting rating embeds while counting successes and failures, finally editing the progress message into a summary embed with up to three captured errors.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Checks that a rating channel is configured and resolvable, picks a random non-bot member, posts one generated rating embed, and confirms the sender.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Resolves a mentioned or ID-provided text channel, calls setRatingChannel to persist the config and start scheduling, then replies with a confirmation embed.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Verifies auto-rating is active for the guild, calls stopRating to clear the config and cancel the timer, and replies with a stopped confirmation embed.

nodes.name: getAdmins
nodes.summary: Returns the in-memory auto-rating admin list for a guild, defaulting to an empty array when none exist.

nodes.name: addAdmin
nodes.summary: Creates the per-guild admin list on demand and appends a user, returning false when the user is already present.

nodes.name: removeAdmin
nodes.summary: Finds a user by ID in the guild's admin list and splices them out, returning false when the list or user is missing.

nodes.name: getRandomMember
nodes.summary: Fetches up to 100 guild members, filters out bots, and returns a random human member or null when none are found or the fetch fails.

nodes.name: buildRatingEmbed
nodes.summary: Builds a rating embed for a member with a randomized star score and color, optionally appending fake-review fields (order number, service time, admin, price, payment method, comment) when fake reviews are enabled.

nodes.name: scheduleNext
nodes.summary: Cancels any pending timer for the guild and schedules the next sendAutoRating run after a randomized 1–2 hour delay, logging the chosen interval.

nodes.name: sendAutoRating
nodes.summary: Sends one generated rating embed to the guild's configured channel with guards for missing guild, channel, or members, then re-schedules itself to keep the loop running.

nodes.name: setRatingChannel
nodes.summary: Stores the rating channel for a guild, clears any existing timer, and kicks off the scheduling loop for the new configuration.

nodes.name: stopRating
nodes.summary: Cancels the guild's pending timer and deletes its rating configuration to fully disable auto-ratings.

nodes.name: getRatingStatus
nodes.summary: Returns the configured channel ID for a guild, or null when auto-rating has not been set up.

nodes.name: edit.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/gedit` that updates a giveaway's prize and duration by message ID, then refreshes the posted giveaway message with an enter button and Components V2 container.

nodes.name: end.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/gend` that force-ends a giveaway immediately by delegating to the giveaway service's endGiveaway helper.

nodes.name: list.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/glist` that renders every active giveaway in the guild inside a Discord Components V2 container with separators and timestamps.

nodes.name: pause.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/gpause` that pauses an active giveaway and rewrites its message with a disabled enter button so no new entries are accepted.

nodes.name: reroll.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/greroll` that picks a fresh random winner from an ended giveaway's participants and announces the result in the channel.

nodes.name: resume.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/gresume` that resumes a paused giveaway and re-enables the enter button on its message.

nodes.name: start.js
nodes.summary: Slash command `/gstart` that parses a human-readable duration, creates a giveaway through the giveaway service, and posts the hosted message with an enter button before linking its message ID.
nodes.languageNotes: Follows the standard discord.js command contract: module.exports carries a SlashCommandBuilder `data` descriptor plus an `async execute(interaction)` handler.

nodes.name: giveaway.js
nodes.summary: Core giveaway service that persists giveaway state to giveaways.json, exposes lifecycle helpers (create, pause, resume, end, reroll, edit), and runs a 10-second timer that picks winners and rewrites ended giveaway messages.
nodes.languageNotes: CommonJS module using a module-level array mutated by helpers and flushed to a JSON file; an setInterval loop drives periodic end-of-giveaway checks.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/gedit` by reading prize and duration options, validating the duration, calling editGiveaway, and re-fetching the giveaway message to update its displayed content.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/gend` by resolving the message ID option, invoking endGiveaway, and replying with the outcome or an error message.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/glist` by fetching active giveaways for the guild and formatting them into a Components V2 container, or replying with an empty-state message.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/gpause` by calling pauseGiveaway, then re-fetching the giveaway message to disable the enter button and mark the giveaway as paused.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/greroll` by obtaining a new random winner from rerollGiveaway, fetching that user, and announcing them as the new winner.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/gresume` by calling resumeGiveaway, then re-fetching the message to re-enable the enter button and show the updated end time.

nodes.name: execute
nodes.summary: Handles `/gstart` by validating the guild context and duration string, creating the giveaway, posting the announcement message with an enter button, and storing its message ID.

nodes.name: loadGiveawaysFromFile
nodes.summary: Reads giveaways.json from disk into the in-memory giveaways array, silently tolerating a missing or corrupt file.

nodes.name: loadGiveaways
nodes.summary: Initializes giveaway state from disk at startup and schedules checkEndedGiveaways to run on a 10-second interval.

nodes.name: getGiveaway
nodes.summary: Looks up a giveaway record by its Discord message ID from the in-memory list.

nodes.name: addParticipant
nodes.summary: Adds a user to a giveaway's participant list unless the giveaway is paused or the user already entered, then persists the change.

nodes.name: createGiveaway
nodes.summary: Builds a new giveaway record with a computed end time and empty participant list, appends it to the store, and persists it.

nodes.name: setMessageId
nodes.summary: Stores the Discord message ID on a giveaway record after the host message has been sent, then saves state.

nodes.name: pauseGiveaway
nodes.summary: Marks a giveaway as paused with a pause timestamp so end-checks skip it, returning whether the transition succeeded.

nodes.name: resumeGiveaway
nodes.summary: Unpauses a giveaway by shifting its end time forward by the paused duration, preserving the remaining time.

nodes.name: endGiveaway
nodes.summary: Forces a giveaway's end time to the current time so the next scheduled sweep resolves and announces a winner.

nodes.name: rerollGiveaway
nodes.summary: Randomly selects a new winner from an ended giveaway's participant list, returning null when nobody entered.

nodes.name: editGiveaway
nodes.summary: Updates a giveaway's prize and/or recalculates its end time from a new duration, persisting the changes when the giveaway exists.

nodes.name: getActiveGiveaways
nodes.summary: Filters giveaways for a guild whose end time is still in the future.

nodes.name: checkEndedGiveaways
nodes.summary: Periodic sweep that finds expired, unpaused giveaways, picks a random winner (or reports that nobody entered), rewrites the giveaway message with Components V2, announces the winner, and prunes finished records.

nodes.name: AGENT-REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive analysis report of the Mikasa bot covering architecture, current features, a full file map with per-file purposes, gap analysis against client requirements, technical recommendations, risks, and a quick-reference of key file locations.

nodes.name: AUDIT-REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Code audit of the Discord.js v14 bot reporting syntax and module-load failures, traffic-test results, and a prioritized P0-P3 bug list alongside performance, security, and integrity findings for the follow-up coding agent.

nodes.name: IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Detailed marketplace-transformation plan specifying the question-flow redesign, seller and buyer submission flows, AI evaluation and support agents, 24-hour admin review timer, trusted-client detection, and a 12-step implementation order with a testing checklist.

nodes.name: IMPROVEMENTS.md
nodes.summary: Prioritized improvement backlog grouping critical bug fixes, JSON/performance upgrades, feature ideas such as a web storefront and Stripe payments, code-quality refactors, and reliability/ops hardening into a color-coded priority order.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for system-bot declaring the start script and runtime dependencies: discord.js for the bot, Express/EJS for the web dashboard, Groq and Google Gemini SDKs for AI evaluation, Passport Discord auth, and pro.db storage.
nodes.languageNotes: Both the `main` field and the `start` script resolve to `index.js`, so the entire bot runs as a single Node process started with `npm start`.

nodes.name: terms-dev.md
nodes.summary: Developer Terms of Service with 28 numbered clauses covering conduct, project requirements, payment and withdrawal rules, ownership and confidentiality, disputes and termination, plus payment-split guidance for single and multi-developer projects.

nodes.name: terms.md
nodes.summary: Buyer-facing customer-protection notice presented before placing an order, covering payment protection, refund eligibility, one free revision, daily progress updates, and a no-direct-messages rule with a pointer to the full terms channel.

nodes.name: ticket-config.json
nodes.summary: Runtime configuration for the ticket system: guild, role, category and channel IDs, ticket counter and per-guild limits, five selectable ticket types (support, buy, apply, sell, buy request), and every user-facing message template including submission, AI-analysis and trusted-client strings.

nodes.name: Applying system.md
nodes.summary: Specification for the developer/staff application flow: an Apply button in the apply ticket triggers a 10-question form with a role selector and terms agreement, followed by the commission rules (60/40 server-referred vs 90/10 direct-client split, multi-developer division, $100 minimum, and general payment rules).

nodes.name: COMPILED-MESSAGES.md
nodes.summary: Master catalog of every user-facing bot message and embed, organized by system (tickets, payments, verification, moderation, giveaways, protection, logging, dashboard) with source line references into the implementing files, plus a section of planned messages still to implement.

nodes.name: Payments on development services.md
nodes.summary: Brief spec for the /payments-method command, which posts an embed with a select menu offering two payment schedules: 'Method 01 - 50% then 50%' and 'Method 02 - Part After Part'.

nodes.name: Portfolio Scanner Report.md
nodes.summary: Research report and implementation guide for the portfolio scanner: pipeline architecture, keyword and regex pattern matching, link freshness analysis, AI-text detection (perplexity, burstiness, phrase dictionary), stolen-content detection, scoring/classification, false-positive mitigation, admin report format, and a full module skeleton.

nodes.name: Projects tickets - Payment.md
nodes.summary: Spec for the client buy-ticket flow: Service vs Developer selection, an 8-question project intake form with role multi-select and terms agreement, saving answers to a file, an admin accept/decline embed, and the developer apply/accept flow — including the shared payment split and commission rules.

nodes.name: Questions Answering System.md
nodes.summary: One-paragraph description of the sequential question flow: each question is presented with a button that opens a form, answers are saved after each submission until the set is complete via the Saving system, with input validation for answer formats.

nodes.name: SYSTEMS-REQUIREMENTS.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive requirements and database specification covering the saving system, question-answering flow, project ticket/payment flow, payment methods, applying system, shared utilities and persistence, channel/role ID references, and complete module skeletons for savingSystem.js, questionFlow.js, projectTicket.js, and applySystem.js.

nodes.name: Saving system.md
nodes.summary: Short spec for persisting question/answer sessions as formatted .md files that record the developer or project owner, with each save routed to the dedicated Discord channel for developer applications or client projects.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Understand-Anything tooling configuration that pins the generated knowledge graph output language to English.

nodes.name: help.js
nodes.summary: Interactive /help slash command that renders a paginated, button-navigable command catalog grouped into nine sections using Discord Components V2 containers and a timed message component collector.
nodes.languageNotes: Built on Discord.js v14 Components V2 (ContainerBuilder, TextDisplayBuilder, SeparatorBuilder) with a 5-minute message component collector that swaps sections on button presses and rewrites the message to an expiry notice when the collector ends.

nodes.name: getHelpContainer
nodes.summary: Builds the Components V2 container for a help section, laying out its title, description, and one separator-plus-command-listing pair per command.

nodes.name: getHelpRows
nodes.summary: Builds the two button rows used to switch help sections, highlighting the currently active section with a success-styled button.

nodes.name: payments-method.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that posts a string select menu letting users pick a payment method (upfront payment or alternatives) for marketplace transactions.

nodes.name: ping.js
nodes.summary: Minimal /ping slash command that measures round-trip message latency and WebSocket API ping and reports both back to the invoker.

nodes.name: avatar.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that displays a target user's (or the invoker's) 1024px avatar inside a Components V2 media gallery container.

nodes.name: channelinfo.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that renders details about a selected channel — ID, type, and category — in a styled Components V2 container.

nodes.name: roleinfo.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that shows a role's properties — ID, color, member count, and hoisting/mentionable flags — in a Components V2 container.

nodes.name: serverinfo.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that summarizes guild statistics — member and bot counts, creation date, boost level, and channel totals — with a server icon gallery.

nodes.name: userinfo.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that inspects a guild member — account age, join date, roles, and status — fetching the member from cache or the API when needed.

nodes.name: clear.js
nodes.summary: Moderation slash command that bulk-deletes 1–100 recent messages in the current channel after re-checking the Manage Messages permission, with graceful handling of unknown-message errors.

nodes.name: auditlog.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that assigns a log channel for a chosen event category (messages, channels, voice, members, guild, roles, moderation) by persisting the channel ID under a per-guild pro.db key.

nodes.name: disable.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that turns off one of the server protection features (anti-spam, anti-raid, anti-scam, anti-link, channel/role/kick/ban guards) by deleting its per-guild pro.db flag and confirming with a colored embed.

nodes.name: enable.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that activates a chosen protection feature by writing a boolean flag to pro.db under a flat `<guildId>_<feature>` key, with an invalid-choice fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Protection state lives in pro.db as flat string keys of the form `<guildId>_<feature>`; a large switch statement maps each select choice to its key, title, and color.

nodes.name: setlimted.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that configures the action threshold (1–100) at which a protection feature triggers, storing a per-feature limit key in pro.db.
nodes.languageNotes: The command and file name contain the typo 'setlimted' (instead of 'setlimited'); since slash command names are user-facing and registered from this file, the spelling is load-bearing.

nodes.name: setprotectionlog.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that enables or disables protection-event logging by setting or deleting the `<guildId>_logchannel` pro.db key after validating the target is a text channel.

nodes.name: setpunishment.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that stores the punishment applied on protection violations — remove roles, kick, or ban — in pro.db and confirms the choice.

nodes.name: verify.js
nodes.summary: Guild-management slash command that posts a verification prompt with a button in a chosen channel and records the message, channel, and role IDs in pro.db for the verification flow.

nodes.name: whitelist-list.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that displays the users whitelisted for a selected protection feature, resolving each stored user ID to a mention with per-user error fallbacks.

nodes.name: whitelist.js
nodes.summary: Administrator slash command that adds or removes a user from a protection feature's whitelist array in pro.db, guarding against duplicate additions and missing entries.

nodes.name: come.js
nodes.summary: Staff-only slash command that DMs a named user to bring them into the current ticket channel, refusing to run outside ticket channels and handling DM-permission failures.

nodes.name: manage.js
nodes.summary: Ticket staff slash command with `add` and `remove` subcommands that grants or revokes a user's access to the current ticket channel, gated on the staff role from ticket-config.json.

nodes.name: ticketPanel.js
nodes.summary: Admin-only `/setup` slash command that posts the ticket system panel — a branded Components V2 container plus a service select menu (apply, purchase, project request, sell, report) whose choices drive ticket creation.
nodes.languageNotes: The select menu uses the custom id `ticket_starter`, so the choice handler lives in a separate interaction-router file rather than in this command.

nodes.name: announce.js
nodes.summary: Manage-Guild slash command that forwards an announcement message to a chosen text channel, validating channel type before sending.

nodes.name: invite.js
nodes.summary: Slash command that generates and returns the bot's invite URL with the bot and applications.commands scopes plus its full permission set.

nodes.name: say.js
nodes.summary: Manage-Messages slash command that makes the bot repeat a given message in the current channel, mapping missing-permission errors to a friendly ephemeral reply.

nodes.name: inviteCreate.js
nodes.summary: Discord inviteCreate event handler that records the usage count of a newly created invite in the client's invite tracking map for later join-source attribution.

nodes.name: inviteDelete.js
nodes.summary: Discord inviteDelete event handler that evicts a deleted invite code from the client's cached invite map so join attribution stays accurate.

nodes.name: aiAgentScanner.js
nodes.summary: Multi-agent AI portfolio scanner that fans developer application answers out to three specialized Groq LLM agents in parallel and merges their scores, strengths, red flags, and missing-item feedback into one report.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs a Promise.all fan-out over agent configs and strips markdown code fences before JSON.parse so free-form LLM output becomes machine-readable.

nodes.name: aiReportEmbed.js
nodes.summary: Builds the Discord message-component report for an AI portfolio scan: accent-colored containers with score bars, strengths, missing items, red flags, per-agent lines, and a metadata footer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Discord's newer ContainerBuilder / TextDisplayBuilder / SeparatorBuilder component API instead of the classic EmbedBuilder.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Shared dark-theme stylesheet for the Express web dashboard covering header and navigation, cards, product grid, badges, buttons, profile stats, admin review items, footer, and a mobile breakpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Organized into commented section blocks with a single max-width:768px media query that collapses grids and the nav for mobile.

nodes.name: reviews.ejs
nodes.summary: Admin moderation queue template listing pending seller submissions and buyer requests with their answers, AI evaluation scores, admin responses, and accept/decline actions posted to /api/review-action.

nodes.name: dashboard.ejs
nodes.summary: User dashboard template rendering the logged-in member's Discord servers as manage cards, with an Arabic/English language toggle and staggered card entrance animations.

nodes.name: error.ejs
nodes.summary: Minimal standalone error page rendering an optional message passed by the Express error handler plus a link back to the home page.

nodes.name: index.ejs
nodes.summary: Public landing page offering Discord OAuth login and bot invite links, a bot feature list, and a client-side Arabic/English RTL language switcher.
nodes.languageNotes: Renders Arabic right-to-left by default and flips document.dir, lang, and every text node client-side when the language button is pressed.

nodes.name: index.ejs
nodes.summary: Marketplace catalog template filtering and listing Roblox products by category and search text, with a purchase button that posts to /api/purchase-product.

nodes.name: my-products.ejs
nodes.summary: Seller-facing template listing the current user's marketplace products with status badges and a removal action that posts to /api/remove-product.

nodes.name: profile.ejs
nodes.summary: User profile page showing the trust badge, marketplace statistics, recent listings, purchases, and reviews, with a logged-out fallback that links to Discord OAuth.

nodes.name: recaptcha.ejs
nodes.summary: Arabic right-to-left reCAPTCHA challenge page that renders Google's reCAPTCHA widget and submits the form response to /verify-recaptcha.

nodes.name: server-dashboard.ejs
nodes.summary: Per-guild control panel template rendering anti-raid and moderation protection toggles, per-command enable switches, and a marketplace management tab, all wired to CSRF-protected JSON APIs.
nodes.languageNotes: Generates bilingual toggle cards by looping EJS over protection-type arrays and indexing inline Arabic/English lookup maps by key.

nodes.name: verify.ejs
nodes.summary: Account verification page that POSTs the guild ID, user ID, and CSRF token to /verify, then reports success or failure inline with a loading spinner.

nodes.name: buildPortfolioText
nodes.summary: Flattens developer application answers and application metadata into a markdown text block formatted for the LLM agent prompts.

nodes.name: callAgent
nodes.summary: Sends the portfolio text to one configured Groq chat agent, strips markdown fences from the reply, parses the JSON, and returns a normalized result or an error entry.

nodes.name: aggregateResults
nodes.summary: Merges the per-agent results into a single report with an averaged score, classification tally, combined strengths, missing items and red flags, evidence excerpts, and per-category sub-scores.

nodes.name: scanPortfolioWithAI
nodes.summary: Exported entry point that builds the portfolio text, runs every configured AI agent concurrently, and returns the aggregated evaluation report.

nodes.name: buildAIAgentReportEmbed
nodes.summary: Assembles the complete Discord report payload for an AI portfolio scan, chaining containers for the classification header, score bars, strengths, missing items, red flags, per-agent lines, and metadata.

nodes.name: changeLanguage
nodes.summary: Swaps every landing page string between Arabic and English, flips document direction, and replays the entrance animations on the changed elements.

nodes.name: toggleLanguage
nodes.summary: Toggles the dashboard title, action buttons, and empty-state message between Arabic and English and switches the document direction.

nodes.name: toggleCommand
nodes.summary: POSTs a command enable/disable change for a guild to /api/toggle-command together with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: toggleProtection
nodes.summary: POSTs an anti-raid or moderation protection toggle for a guild to /api/toggle-protection together with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: removeProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms with the admin and posts product deletion to /api/remove-product, reloading the control panel when the server reports success.

nodes.name: acceptReview
nodes.summary: Confirms and submits an accept action for a pending review to /api/review-action with the CSRF token, then reloads the queue.

nodes.name: declineReview
nodes.summary: Prompts the admin for a reason and posts the decline action for a pending review to /api/review-action with the CSRF token.

nodes.name: purchaseProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms and submits a product purchase to /api/purchase-product with the CSRF token, reloading the catalog on success.

nodes.name: removeProduct
nodes.summary: Confirms and posts a product removal to /api/remove-product with the CSRF token, reloading the seller's listing grid on success.
